problem.finding: V3 requires a global single-owned-policy receipt and per-edge induced-by-bound-policy receipts but does not structurally bind those receipts to one exact policy identity, policy implementation blob, policy epoch, claimed acceptance domain, or exact macroedge bytes.
problem.consequence: A split-policy certificate can satisfy every V3 Boolean obligation while edge witnesses are supplied by different policies, recreating the forbidden forall-edge-exists-policy quantifier order.

independent_logic_check.formula: ((b11 OR b12) AND (b21 OR b22)) AND NOT((b11 AND b21) OR (b12 AND b22))
independent_logic_check.interpretation: Each of two edges has a policy witness, but no single one of the two policies witnesses both edges.

repair.effect: The legacy split-policy witness is structurally rejected before V3 graph and semantic checks run.
